name: focus-lock
description: Start a timed sprint on one task with /sprint. Prompts about anything else are held until the timer ends.

minutes.title: Sprint length
minutes.description: Minutes a sprint runs when /sprint is given no number.

model.title: Judge model
model.description: The model that decides whether a prompt is on task. A small, fast one is best.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: End-of-sprint sound volume, from 0 (silent) to 4 (loud). 1 is normal.
